meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Grinder's Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Prove your physical endurance by navigating the Smelter-Spine and securing the perimeter of the Gyre-Bastion.
improvisation_points: Consult Overseer Kovak for the training route.
Pass the security check with Sentry Aris.
Report your successful completion to Lead-Driller Grock.

quests.title: The Gilded Claim
quests.narrative_guidance: Defend a valuable ore shipment from Krupp-4 Prime to the deep reaches of Marrow-Deep.
improvisation_points: Receive the shipment manifest from Trade-Boss Marda.
Calibrate the transport rings with Tech Liora.
Deliver the ores safely to Air-Warden Mina.

quests.title: Syndicate Infiltration
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate rumors of a Syndicate spy hiding within the Centrifuge Barracks.
improvisation_points: Track the thermal leaks with Vane the Volatile.
Interrogate suspects under Sergeant Kael's supervision.
Hand the spy over to Tunnel-Rat for processing.

quests.title: Flagship Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: A rival faction flagship is nearing the Ironlords' territory. Disrupt their sensors.
improvisation_points: Steal the sensor codes from Scrap-King Zigg.
Relay the jamming signal to Watcher Soren.
Confirm the ship's retreat with Crusher Uln.

quests.title: Storm Rift Salvage
quests.narrative_guidance: Retrieve ancient wreckage from the Storm Rift before it is lost to the void.
improvisation_points: Get coordinates from Harbor Inspector Sela.
Recover the scrap using Frenn the Scav's nets.
Deliver the materials to Forge-Master Halvek for analysis.

quests.title: Mercenary's Loyalty
quests.narrative_guidance: A new pilot claims loyalty to the Ironlords, but their background is suspicious.
improvisation_points: Vet the pilot's physical strength with Burt the Bruiser.
Check the pilot's IDs with Jax Corven.
Receive a final blessing/judgment from Elder Orlen.

quests.title: The Maw's Resonance
quests.narrative_guidance: The tectonic stabilizers are failing due to a strange signal. Silence the source.
improvisation_points: Analyze the engine stress with Chief Dorn.
Secure the anchor point with Master Bane.
Reprogram the source at Unit MAW-01.

quests.title: The Axial Calibration
quests.narrative_guidance: The station's spin is wobbling. Sero Vane needs a specific mineral filter from the Ore Spindles, which must then be installed in the high-G momentum ring.
improvisation_points: Consult Sero Vane in the Axial Core about the vibration dampeners.
Retrieve the Sifter-Grade Filter from Kaelen Drass in the Ore Spindles.
Deliver and install the filter with Lyra Thorne in Momentum Ring A.

quests.title: Dr. Halvek's Static Signal
quests.narrative_guidance: A strange frequency is disrupting the Gyre's communications. Dr. Aris has traced it to the Cable Web, and Silas needs the docks cleared for a secret arrival.
improvisation_points: Meet Dr. Aris in the Luminescent Hollows to receive the signal decoder.
Climb the Cable Web to help Nym recalibrate the signal repeaters.
Inform Silas Gray at the Silken Docks that the 'ghost ship' is clear to land.

quests.title: The Reaver's Supply Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Rask Vorn demands more speed. Finn has spotted a freighter, but Tarsus needs parts from the slums to fix the pursuit engines.
improvisation_points: Report to Finn at Scout’s Perch to get the freighter's coordinates.
Acquire high-grade fuel injectors from Mira in the Velocity Slums.
Deliver the parts to Tarsus at the Engine Spine to boost the station's thrusters.

quests.title: Echoes of the Spire
quests.narrative_guidance: Val has noticed strange light patterns in the Refraction Spires. Kael believes they match ancient records in the vaults, and Sera needs to shield the gardens.
improvisation_points: Speak with Val at the Refraction Spires about the pulsing light.
Consult Kael in the Echo Vaults to translate the optical code.
Use the translated code to help Sera tune the Torsion Gardens' shields.

quests.title: Newton's Braking Debt
quests.narrative_guidance: A cargo ship is coming in too hot. Gar needs the braking fins engaged, but the cargo manifests are missing and the ward is in chaos.
improvisation_points: Assist Gar at the Braking Fin with the manual deceleration levers.
Secure the cargo manifests from Harl at the Cargo Flanks.
Deliver the manifests to Lora in the Drift Ward to process the 'recovered' goods.

quests.title: Slag Vent Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Someone is clogging the vents. Brackus suspects a market rival is trying to smoke out the Centrifuge Markets, threatening the lattice structure.
improvisation_points: Meet Brackus in the Slag Vents to clear the debris.
Investigate Zaya Mel's leads in the Centrifuge Markets to find the culprit.
Reinforce the damaged struts with Torin Vorn at the Forge Lattice.

quests.title: The Finality Gambit
quests.narrative_guidance: Elara Kye reports a spy hiding in Glint-Side. Vect is waiting at the station's edge to ensure they don't leave.
improvisation_points: Receive the description of the spy from Elara Kye in the Habitation Spokes.
Track the spy through Glint-Side with the help of Jax.
Intercept the spy before they reach the airlocks at Newton’s End with Vect.

quests.title: The Grinder's Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Prove your worth by calculating a safe flight path through the Smelter Ring without using a nav-computer.
improvisation_points: Consult Scribe Kaelen for manual coordinate charts.
Request the Smelter flow cycles from Foreman Orlen.
Deliver the verified manual flight path to Watcher Orlen.

quests.title: The Gilded Claim
quests.narrative_guidance: Defend a rich mining claim by verifying the ore purity and securing the processing rights.
improvisation_points: Obtain the ore purity standards from Curator Solas.
Audit the Torque Mills output with Miller Vox.
Log the final mineral analysis with Researcher Vox.

quests.title: The Static Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate a hidden laboratory and decrypt the Syndicate data hidden within resonance frequencies.
improvisation_points: Receive the encrypted transmission from Overseer Mura.
Locate the decryption key in Dr. Halvek's Slag Canyon lab.
Broadcast the decrypted data via the Resonance Chambers with Sound-Tech Halvek.

quests.title: The Iron Vein Strike
quests.narrative_guidance: Identify and eliminate a pirate threat using the Assembly's temporal and forge technologies.
improvisation_points: Obtain the pirate's last known temporal location from Chrono-Tech Drax.
Track the pirate flagship to Centrifuge Row and confront Rask.
Harness the Singularity Forge under Striker Vorn's supervision to destroy the wreckage.

quests.title: The Queen's Favor
quests.narrative_guidance: Gather high-value wreckage to satisfy the demands of the Assembly's scavenger leaders.
improvisation_points: Secure an entry permit from Warden Quenn by promising a tribute.
Collect specialized debris from Lira at the Magnetic Docking Bay.
Offer the refined wreckage to Weaver Quenn at the Needle's Eye.

quests.title: The Shifting Contract
quests.narrative_guidance: Hire a mercenary pilot for a high-risk mission while ensuring their loyalty remains with the Assembly.
improvisation_points: Meet Pilot Jaxen to discuss the target's logistics.
Pay the recruitment fee to Jax at the Hard-Rock Foundry.
Report the successful hire to Guard Corven for deployment.

quests.title: The Maw's Origin
quests.narrative_guidance: Trace the source of the corrupted signals haunting the Kinematic Assembly's systems.
improvisation_points: Analyze the distorted signals coming from Core Echo.
Trace the signal frequency to Anchor Maw in the Tether Anchor.
Decide the AI's fate in the Void-Garden with Garden Maw.
